name: com.csht.activity.BleDevicesActivity
description: The Zhongruan Gaoke ID-card reader SDK opens this page when the app asks the user to choose a Bluetooth reader. It scans for nearby low-energy Bluetooth card readers and lets the user connect to one.
disableEffect: Users cannot find or connect to a Bluetooth card reader through this page, so Bluetooth-based card reading may stop working.
